notes.title: ROTATION UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/de8c4470d0deb219948dacfea058ef6d812637ad.png[/img]

Releasing a game is always exciting!
Will you, the players actually like it?
Guess you do 💖, had a lot of feedback and we want to present you now the most wanted feature:

[h2]ROTATION[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/c62131900107f82df66fcecd29af34fb370f2b81.png[/img]

Puzzle pieces can now be rotated to increase the difficulty and give for a new challenge. It is totally optional to not make it too hard for those who want it more relaxing and has to be enabled in the settings.
We also enabled you to configure the piece snapping strength, to provide a even better challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/336f11c35f4db7003566782b6c2e67c11c03b332.png[/img]

There are also a lot of little bug fixes, improvements and the new [b]SHUFFLE [/b] pieces button in game.

Have fun puzzeling 💖

- the SpielmannSpiel Team
